description: Academic journal style profiles, US/UK spelling pairs, and colloquial/Chinglish/redundancy lint rules.

nature_science.name: Nature / Science Portfolio
nature_science.description: High-impact multidisciplinary concise active-voice style with strict evidence restraint.
nature_science.recommended_person: first_person_plural_active (we) allowed in Methods/Results; avoid singular I
nature_science.default_spelling: UK_or_US_consistent (Nature prefers UK; Science prefers US — lock consistently per manuscript)
nature_science.abbr_rules: Define non-standard abbreviations at first mention in Abstract and separately in main text; minimize acronyms.
nature_science.tone_guidelines: Concise, punchy, non-promotional; separate observed data from speculation.

ieee_acm.name: IEEE / ACM Engineering & CS
ieee_acm.description: Technical precision, structured problem formulation, US spelling default.
ieee_acm.abbr_rules: Define in Abstract if used there and again at first occurrence in body; avoid undefined system acronyms.
ieee_acm.tone_guidelines: Quantitative, precise; avoid marketing adjectives (revolutionary, state-of-the-art without benchmark).

elsevier_general.name: Elsevier / Springer General Science
elsevier_general.description: Standard international peer-reviewed research article style.
elsevier_general.abbr_rules: Define all non-standard abbreviations at first mention; maintain consistent hyphenation.
elsevier_general.tone_guidelines: Formal, objective, clear logical transitions without empty filler.

medical_clinical.name: Medical / Clinical (NEJM / Lancet / JAMA style)
medical_clinical.description: Strict causal vs associative distinction, patient-first phrasing, CONSORT/STROBE alignment.
medical_clinical.abbr_rules: Minimize clinical abbreviations; never alter drug/gene/biomarker nomenclature.
medical_clinical.tone_guidelines: Strict hedging on observational associations; preserve exact cohort bounds, p-values, CIs, and adverse-event qualifiers.

zh_core_journal.name: Chinese Core Academic Journal (中文核心期刊/自然科学基金)
zh_core_journal.description: 规范中文学术论文与基金申请书语域，去口语化、去翻译腔、统一全半角与术语。
zh_core_journal.recommended_person: impersonal (本研究/本文) preferred; avoid 我/我们 in formal results except grant narratives
zh_core_journal.abbr_rules: 首次出现给出中文全称及英文全称与缩写，格式为：中文全称（English Full Name, ABBR）；后文直接使用ABBR。
zh_core_journal.tone_guidelines: 严谨克制，避免'非常不错'、'众所周知'、'极大地'等宣传性/口语化表达；精简'进行了……的研究'等冗余名词化。

general_academic.name: General Academic (Default Fallback)
general_academic.description: Neutral international academic register when target journal/genre is unspecified.
general_academic.abbr_rules: Define at first occurrence in Abstract and Body separately; keep expansion consistent.
general_academic.tone_guidelines: Objective, formal, minimal-edit preservation of authorial intent and epistemic strength.

en.suggestion: Use 'numerous', 'substantial', or quantify explicitly.
Replace vague intensifier with precise academic adjective (e.g., 'favorable', 'marked', 'substantial').
Use 'increasingly' or 'a growing number of'.
Use 'currently', 'at present', or 'in recent studies'.
Use 'in summary' or 'collectively'.
Avoid assertive filler 'obviously'; state the supporting evidence directly.

en.pattern: \bit is well known that\b|\bas we all know\b|\bas is known to all\b
en.suggestion: Cite primary literature or state established background concisely without cliché.
Use 'eliminate', 'remove', or 'mitigate'.
Use 'conduct', 'perform', or 'carry out' experiments.
Refer specifically (e.g., 'based on the foregoing analysis' or 'as shown in Section X').
Use precise mechanistic verb (e.g., 'is critical for', 'mediates', 'contributes substantially to').
Replace cliché opener with specific scientific context or motivation.
Expand contractions in formal academic prose (unless inside verbatim quote/code).
Use 'somewhat', 'moderately', or quantify.
Avoid 'and so on' in formal prose; name representative items or restructure.
Do not combine 'such as' with 'etc.' (redundant).
Use 'Moreover,', 'Furthermore,', or 'In addition,' instead of sentence-initial 'Besides,'.
Replace promotional/colloquial adjective with objective descriptor.
Avoid stacked cliché openers; lead directly with the research gap.
Remove 'so' when clause starts with 'Because' (comma splice / Chinglish transfer).
Remove 'but' when clause starts with 'Although/Though'.
Consider simplifying 'in order to' to 'to' where unambiguous.
Simplify to 'because' or 'since'.
Often removable without loss; integrate the point directly.
Replace vague noun with specific entity (e.g., 'factors', 'parameters', 'components').
Use 'determine', 'elucidate', or 'identify'.
Use 'discuss', 'examine', or 'address'.
Use 'numerous' or 'extensive' in formal prose.
Simplify to 'Several studies have...' or 'Prior work has...'.
Use 'perhaps' or modal 'may/might' in academic prose.

zh.pattern: 进行了.{1,15}的(?:研究|探讨|分析|实验|测试)
zh.suggestion: 精简'进行了……的研究'冗余名词化，改为主动动词短语（如'研究/分析了……'）。

zh.pattern: 非常不错|挺好的|相当不错|很棒
zh.suggestion: 替换为客观学术评价（如'表现较优'、'具备良好性能'）。

zh.pattern: 总而言之|一言以蔽之|说白了
zh.suggestion: 使用'综上所述'、'综上'等规范学术衔接语。

zh.pattern: 众所周知|尽人皆知|不言而喻
zh.suggestion: 避免空泛断言，直接给出文献依据或客观事实陈述。

zh.pattern: 极大地|极其显著地|前所未有地|革命性地
zh.suggestion: 克制宣传化副词，优先给出具体提升幅度与统计指标。

zh.pattern: 搞清楚|弄明白|看一看|做一下
zh.suggestion: 改为'阐明'、'明确'、'考察'、'开展'等书面学术动词。

zh.pattern: (?:很多|好多)(?:学者|研究|工作|实验)
zh.suggestion: 改为'诸多'、'多项'或直接列举代表性文献。
改为'日益增多'或'逐渐受到关注'。

zh.pattern: 起着非常?重要的作用|扮演着?重要的角色
zh.suggestion: 直接指出具体机制或贡献（如'对……具有关键调控作用'）。
慎用绝对化副词，改为基于数据与推理的表述。

zh.pattern: 当谈到|说到这里|换句话说
zh.suggestion: 改为'针对……'、'具体而言'或'亦即'。

zh.pattern: 不可否认的是|不得不承认
zh.suggestion: 删除主观引导语，直接陈述事实。

zh.pattern: 下面我们|接下来我们来看看
zh.suggestion: 改为'下文将'或'本节进一步分析'。
检查是否为生硬翻译腔，确认有比较基准或改写为更紧凑的定语结构。

zh.pattern: 差不多|大概其|几乎差不多
zh.suggestion: 改为'相近'、'约'或给出具体数值范围。
